description: Selling price, profit, markup and margin from any two of them, with why a 50% markup is not a 50% margin. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

cost.description: What one item costs you (purchase or production cost), in major units: 80 for $80.00, 1500 for ¥1500.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR, GBP, JPY. Decides the rounding of the amounts: cents for most, whole units for JPY and KRW, thousandths for KWD. Defaults to USD.

margin.description: Gross margin in percent of the SELLING PRICE: 25 means a quarter of the price is profit. Must be below 100. Not the same as markup: a 50% markup is a 33.33% margin.

markup.description: Markup in percent of the COST: 50 means the price is cost + 50% of cost. Negative for selling below cost; above -100.

price.description: The selling price of one item, in the same currency as cost, before VAT or sales tax.
